notes: Page states the serial is ten characters. Month is HELD, NOT SHIPPED: the month is the 5th character (a letter) whose mapping is chart-image-only (Style-1_ADP-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png); this style ships year-only and the month is held for the image pass.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-based: year = 3rd & 4th positions, month = 5th position (letter chart, image-only, held), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Page example shown spaced as '5610 M00000'; normalized form used here. Year value derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.
